sentence_text: A cookie is a piece of information that a web server may place on your computer when you visit a website.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Cookies are commonly used by websites to improve the user experience and have not been known to transmit computer viruses or otherwise harm your computer.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Many cookies last only through a single website session, or visit.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Others may have an expiration date, or may remain on your computer until you delete them.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: We may use cookies for a number of purposes—for example, to maintain continuity during a user session, to gather data about the usage of our website for research and other purposes, to store your preferences for certain kinds of information or to store a user name or encrypted identification number so that you do not have to provide this information every time you return to our website.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: To ensure we are publishing content customers need and want, Blackbaud collects aggregated site-visitation statistics using cookies.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: When someone visits the site, a cookie is placed on the customer’s machine (if the customer accepts cookies) or is read if the customer has visited the website previously.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Our cookies will track only your activity relating to your online activity on this website, and will not track your other Internet activity.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: You can decide if and how your computer will accept a cookie by configuring your preferences or options in your browser.
